comparison.workload: Same loop program bytes, eight public uint64 inputs, output register, and approved transition count for direct and optimistic runs.
comparison.directBaseline: Benchmark-only non-view contract executes BisectVerifier.validateProgram and the exact BisectVerifier.step implementation for every transition in one transaction.
comparison.honestOptimistic: Actual submitClaim with exact prover bond, then permissionless finalize and actual pull withdrawal after the challenge window.
comparison.disputedLifecycle: Actual dishonest same-output trace claim, challenger bond, both authenticated child-hash moves per round, both terminal reveals, one-step adjudication, settlement and actual withdrawal.
comparison.gasAndCollateral: Gas is measured from receipts. msg.value bonds are tracked as collateral deposits and never added to gas cost.
comparison.directDoesNotModelProofSettlement: Direct baseline measures computation only and excludes a claim protocol or financial settlement; lifecycle comparisons state this explicitly.

failedChallengeAgainstHonestProver.outcome: PROVER_TRANSITION_VALID; challenger bond credited to prover; claim then finalized

proverTimeout.outcome: PROVER_TIMEOUT; both bonds credited to challenger after missed move deadline

economics.slashedCollateralExplanation: Four invalid-prover wins and one prover timeout each redistribute the prover's bond; one failed challenge redistributes the challenger's bond. Bonds remain ETH liabilities until withdrawal.

notes: Bond deposits are transaction value and collateral, not gas expense.
The claimant bond and its deposit gas are the same submitClaim receipt; the challenger bond and its deposit gas are the same challenge receipt.
The isolated verifier harness transaction is reported separately and is not included in dispute lifecycle totals.

One-step adjudication receipt gas includes terminal membership verification, transition verification, settlement storage writes and events; the isolated harness receipt separately measures the verifier library call path.
Local Anvil gas prices and block execution do not predict Base Sepolia inclusion fees or congestion.
